declarations.docstring: If the normalized squared norm of a character difference is one and the dimension difference is positive, that difference is the character of a simple representation.
The dimension of the selected character-difference representation is the difference of the two original dimensions.
A complex finite-dimensional representation selected from a normalized character difference with positive dimension difference.
The character of the selected representation is the difference of the two given characters.
The representation selected from the character-difference hypotheses is simple.
